note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Sacramento Arm of Shasta Lake at Lakehead, under oak and pine. The sites sit back from the shore behind a band of trees, with paths down to the water from several of them. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility/rates/catalog + FS page + alerts + imagery/3DEP read. $30 (first-come off-season) to $32 (summer reservation season) single; doubles $60-64; extra vehicle $12. 23 sites (22 RV) + 2 yurts, no hookups, no dump; reservations May 9-Sep 11 only, FCFS otherwise (Scan & Pay), 6 sites FCFS always; 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums. Lakefront -> LAKEVIEW proposed (nearest pads 25-45 m from full pool behind a tree band). Pin ~360 m south of the sites -> 40.8730,-122.3886. Potable water conflict (rec.gov yes, FS page no).
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront -> LAKEVIEW proposed): the stored evidence rests on 'peninsula sites near the shoreline with open drawdown apron' - the drawdown apron is lake bed below full pool and cannot earn the value. Measured instead to the full-pool line: rec.gov gives Shasta Lake at 1,067 ft (325.2 m; ~326 m if the figure is NGVD29 against 3DEP's NAVD88). 3DEP transects east from each rec.gov field position put the closest pads at 25 m (site 003, pad 328.4 m, 40.87467,-122.38852), 38 m (002), 40 m (005, 017), 43 m (004, 016) and 45 m (015), 3-4.5 m above the line over a gentle slope; the other sites are 48-68 m back and 5-8 m up. Imagery shows a continuous belt of pine and oak, ~15-25 m deep, between every site row and the shore, so no site sits over open ground to the high-water edge. rec.gov's own wording is 'direct access to the lake from a number of sites' (paths), and the catalog carries no 'Waterfront' tags. No --AWH value involved.

PIN MOVE ~360 m (suggested): stored 40.86980,-122.38950 is a cluster of buildings and parking ~135 m south of the southernmost site (026 at 40.87102,-122.38883). The 25 rec.gov field positions run 40.87102-40.87499 along -122.3884 to -122.3890; suggest 40.8730,-122.3886 (middle of the loop). The FS page's own point is 40.87224,-122.38754 (near the shore, inside the span).
POTABLE WATER CONFLICT: rec.gov says 'Drinking water and flush toilets are provided'; the FS page (updated 2025-08-06) says 'Potable water is not available at this site'. potable_water left unset.

FEES: the FS page's $28 single / $58 double / $95 yurt is older than rec.gov's current $30-32 / $60-64 / $100-105 (rec.gov fees outrank). The public boat launch nearby charges a separate $17 daily fee.

SITES: count 24 -> 23 (25 catalog units = 23 campsites + 2 yurts; 011 is tent-only). max_rig_ft kept at 30 from rec.gov's 'Average maximum trailer size is 30 feet', although the per-site Max Vehicle Length reads 45 ft on 22 sites (an average-trailer notice and a per-site field disagree; the smaller is kept).

PHONE / WEBSITE: unchanged (530-275-1587, Shasta Lake Ranger Station; rec.gov page). rec.gov also links 'Shasta Recreation Company' (shastatrinitycamping.com), whose campground list was not readable as text; the FS page names no concessionaire and says a host is present in the reservation season.

NEIGHBOUR (not vetted): a private RV park with a pool adjoins the campground's north end (~40.8750,-122.3893); nothing in the DB within 1.7 km besides Antlers (11876). Name not established - mention only.
